description: SEC delisting and listing-compliance risk — Delisting risk check for a US-listed company from SEC EDGAR: exchange delisting notices (Form 25 / 25-NSE), deregistrations (Form 15), 8-K Item 3.01 listing-deficiency notices (minimum bid, equity, late reports), late-filing notices (NT 10-K/10-Q), restatements (Item 4.02), auditor changes and reverse-split hints, scored to a verdict LOW / WATCH / HIGH / DELISTED / DEREGISTERED with dated events and links. Params: ticker= (or cik= for companies already gone from the ticker list), months= window 1-60 (default 24). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_delisting
